votes.motion: based on information and findings set forth in the staff report and upon the evidence and explanations received today, to approve the Conditional Use Permit for a personal instruction service, located at 4256 West 8370 South, in an M-1 zone with the conditions that are supported by substantial evidence as described in the analysis of section IV of the staff report

that the Planning Commission continue the public hearing and consideration and final action regarding the Conditional Use Permit for Outdoor Storage and Operations, located 7880 South 1300 in a C-M zone, to the March 3, 2026, Planning Commission Meeting

that the Planning Commission make a recommendation of Approval (positive recommendation) of the rezone of approximately 1.2 acres from Rural Residential Half Acre Minimum Lots (RR.5D) to Single Family Residential 10,000 Square Foot Minimum Lots (R-1-10) to the West Jordan City Council, subject to all requirements of approval
